description: This file defines the LeaveCommentAPI class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, implementing API endpoints for managing leave comments, including listing and creating comments associated with leave requests.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing leave comments, including listing and creating comments associated with leave requests.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazy loader for the LeaveRequestCommentService instance.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the leave ID from the request URL parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all comments for a specific leave.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET method, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new comment to a leave.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the POST method, requiring a comment string with a max length.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules, primarily that leaveId must be positive.

methods.name: setLeaveComment
methods.description: Populates a LeaveComment object with data from the request.

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Saves the LeaveComment object via the service layer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete method is not implemented; raises an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Delete validation rules are not implemented; raises exception if called.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access rights to view or comment on the leave, throws ForbiddenException if not.
